schema.name: ganglior.node-export
schema.doc: Single-signal ECG analyzer export. All metrics computed from raw ECG only. nulls = not computed at this recording length/quality. Time-series under `timeseries` are the cross-node currency (GlucoDex/CPAPDex/Ganglior consume these).

recording.activityScoreReason: no usable accelerometer stream in the record — activity not measured

timing.reason: host ≡ device — residual spread 0.92 ms ≤ 2 ms (one stamp quantum); this host column is not an independent clock; the rate correction did not reach the published rate: host column is not a second clock (residual spread 0.92 ms, within one stamp quantum — the host stamp is the device stamp rounded), fs left on the device clock; nothing here sizes the published ppm: the spine measured no sigma-y curve on this axis, so the rate travels without its spread

quality.correctionNote: beats replaced by local median: low-SQI + out-of-range + ectopic (>20% from local median, Malik/Kubios). ectopicBeatsCorrected isolates the ectopy-only fixes — these clean rMSSD/pNN50 of PAC/PVC spikes so the HRV agrees with PulseDex/Kubios.
quality.sqiNote: kSQI · bSQI(±50ms) · RR-plausibility · flatline/rail · amplitude. Per-surge SQI rides on each Ganglior event as `sqi` (separate from `conf`, which now scales to CVHR surge magnitude).
quality.coverageNote: analyzablePct = cleanBeatPct × coverage. coverage = active(beat-covered) time ÷ raw span; stray beats after strap-off do not inflate duration.

time.geometricNote: Baevsky-SI inputs (Brennan/Welltory convention): amo50 = amplitude of the modal RR (%), mode = modal RR (ms), mxDMn = RR variation range (SECONDS). Same values as the ⬇ HRVDex CSV columns; null when the NN series is empty.
time.windowNote: sdnn/rmssd/pnn50 here are DISPLAY values = representative 5-min epoch median on overnight recordings (short recs: whole-record). For CROSS-NODE comparison use wholeRecordSDNN/wholeRecordRMSSD (whole-record) or sdnnIndex (mean of per-5-min SDNN).

frequency.respRateNote: respRate = whole-night scalar; respRateEpochStats = per-5-min EDR spread (min/max/median/sd) for resp-rate-instability screening (CPAPDex)

thresholds.decelCapacityNote: DC<4.5 ms = elevated all-cause mortality marker (PRSA, Bauer 2006)
thresholds.ialsNote: inverse avg run length — higher=more fragmented

profile.note: All fields the user entered/selected in the profile panel. null = left on auto/default.

assumedDefaults.source: population norm (NHANES age×sex; Tanaka HRmax) — the value the analysis ran on
assumedDefaults.note: null = the user supplied this field, so no default was needed. A non-null value here is NOT a measurement of this person.

personalization.altitudeFactorFormula: no elevation entered → null; elev≤1500m → 1; else 1 − 0.0033·(elev−1500)/100

cardiorespiratory.crcPLVReason: no complete 60 s coupling window in the record — phase locking not computable
cardiorespiratory.method: EDR (R-peak amplitude modulation) ⟷ RR coupling — ECG-only, no airflow/PPG

refs.rsaEfficiency: Border et al. 2025 arXiv:2507.00597 (RSA minimises cardiac power; ~1.5× insp HR optimum)

cardiorespiratory.interpretation: rsaEfficiencyRatio = insp:exp HR ratio (higher = stronger RSA). crcPLV & couplingStrength ∈ [0,1]; both drop during CVHR/apnea clusters (plvDuringSurges < plvBaseline) → a CVHR confidence channel. All derived from existing pipeline outputs — zero new sensors.

intervals.reason: no valid median beat (insufficient clean aligned normal beats)

morphology.qtcTrendNote: Withheld — recording too short / too few clean windows for a QTc trend (single summary QTc in `intervals` only).

afScreen.note: RR-irregularity screen only — P-wave weak at 130 Hz

timeseries.doc: Per-5-min-epoch aggregates — the primary cross-node feed. GlucoDex regresses epochRMSSD/epochHR for nocturnal autonomic-instability → IR-risk; epoch.qtc (when present, nearest 15-min windowed QTc) lets it line QTc up against overnight glucose.

reserved.doc: Fields awaiting other fleet nodes/models; null until available.
